name: The Masquerade
detailed_description:
Game Description

Masquerade is a small-scale indie AVG (adventure visual novel) inspired by scam compounds.

You will play from the first-person perspective of the protagonist, Youta, delving into the mysterious and brutal world of the so-called "Pigpen Compound."

Three years ago, under coercion from the compound, you shot and killed a medical student, thus "graduating" to become a manager.

Three years later, a trainee nurse named Tsuki, claiming her mother is gravely ill and in urgent need of a kidney transplant, is lured into the compound and becomes one of the "little pigs" trapped inside.

She appears gentle, obedient, and efficient in her tasks.

In this high-pressure environment, a subtle and complex relationship begins to form between you and Tsuki.

As you spend more time with her, you start to notice something strange—and eventually uncover her true purpose for coming here...

You will face numerous choices, torn between cruel reality and your inner conscience, gradually revealing the truth hidden beneath the surface.

Every decision you make may alter your fate and lead to vastly different endings.

Before You Play

  • The "scam compound" depicted in the game is entirely fictional and set in an imagined world. All plot elements have been artistically dramatized and bear no relation to real-life events. We invite you to enjoy this game with the mindset of experiencing a fictional story.

  • Although the game touches on themes inspired by scam compounds, it does not excessively portray extreme violence or cruelty. Instead, it focuses on the characters’ psychological struggles and moral dilemmas, ultimately conveying positive emotions and values.

  • All characters in the game are adults. This story is for entertainment purposes only and does not represent the views or stance of the developers.

  • The narrative is designed to convey uplifting and meaningful values through dramatic conflict. There are no sudden character deaths or plot twists solely for shock value, and the story ultimately leads to a warm and fulfilling ending.

  • Thank you sincerely for choosing to experience our story. We hope you have a meaningful and enjoyable time playing!

Character Profiles

Youta

A mid-level employee of the "Pigpen Compound," Yang is responsible for training and managing the “little pigs,” while also serving as the compound’s infirmary doctor.

Three years ago, you personally shot and killed a student, thus “graduating” into the role of a manager.

Since then, you’ve learned to suppress emotion, calmly carrying out the compound’s cruel rules—just to survive.

But deep inside, a flicker of conscience still lingers…

Tsuki

A trainee nurse deceived into the Pigpen Compound under the pretense of "seeking a kidney donor for her critically ill mother." She becomes "Little Pig No. 317."

Gentle, obedient, and efficient, Tsuki quickly stands out among the others.

Over time, you begin to notice something unusual about her.

In the pressure-cooker environment of the compound, a subtle connection begins to form between you.

Her presence slowly awakens the buried conscience within you—one that threatens to pull your life off its carefully numbed track…

Kawa
A seasoned employee of the compound, your colleague and long-time partner.
He was also your original "guide" when you first entered the system.
Ruthless and pragmatic, he thrives by exploiting victims, showing no mercy toward the “little pigs.”

Seiko
Captain of the compound’s enforcer squad, a formidable fighter deeply trusted by upper management.
She maintains a cold exterior and abides by her own strict personal code.
You encounter her while seeking help—and she becomes a critical part of your escape plan.

Yato
A hacker and master of cyber systems.
He once attempted to escape and paid the price—both legs severed, now wheelchair-bound.
Hidden deep within the compound, he continues his obsession with tech.
He has the ability to alter the compound’s digital records behind the scenes, making him the second key piece of your plan.

Game Scope & Content

  • 2–3 hours to fully explore all story branches

  • Around 100,000 Chinese Characters of non-repetitive text

  • 6 different endings

short_description: "Masquerade" is an independently developed AVG. You will survive in the mysterious and cruel "Little Pig Park" from the first perspective of the male protagonist Youta. There will be multiple choices involved, and you need to struggle between harsh reality and inner conscience, uncovering the truth!

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo 2.0GHz or AMD equivalent performance
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics card is sufficient
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX - compatible sound card

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 3.0GHz or AMD equivalent performance
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 630 or AMD Radeon HD 5570 and above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: High - quality DirectX - compatible sound card
